title: Bind profiles to exact assumptions
description: Define a versioned PrinterProfile identity that binds exact setup, loading revision, configuration revision, sheet-layout identity/revision, and canonical geometry fingerprint without adding physical correction claims.
acceptanceCriteria: A profile stores every exact identity and the canonical geometry fingerprint required by PRD 22
Profile references are schema validated and resolve to immutable revisions
The initial profile shape contains no inferred physical validity or synthetic correction evidence
Serialization and reload preserve exact assumptions

steps.details: Add a versioned serializable PrinterProfile with stable profile ID and exact setup, loading, configuration, layout, revision, and fingerprint references.
Reject missing, malformed, mismatched, or mutable references before persistence and preserve explicit version metadata.
Add local repository round-trip behavior without introducing calibration observations or nonzero correction fields.
Cover valid exact bindings, each invalid reference, fingerprint stability, serialization, and reload with focused tests.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; define identity bindings and repository round-trip only.
This profile is a compatibility-assumption container, not a physically validated calibration profile.
Nonzero translation and physical evidence remain unavailable in this PRD.
